Application Graph and Scene-Local Navigation Scope
nodes.rationale: One application graph owns global state while each window owns its router, paths, pending intent, checkpoint, and write gate so windows remain independent.

nodes.label: Deterministic UI-Test Composition
nodes.rationale: Exact launch roots and fresh in-memory dependencies keep cross-platform UI tests isolated from persisted and shared state.

nodes.label: Portable Build and Replaceable Resources
nodes.rationale: Portable xcconfig values, stable route strings, string catalogs, and neutral assets make the repository reusable as an application template.

nodes.label: Native Cross-Platform App Shell Implementation Plan
Typed Network Request Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Typed targets flow through a pure builder, ordered asynchronous adapters and monitors, a replaceable transport, validation, and raw response decoding.

nodes.label: macOS UI-Test Window Isolation Implementation Plan
Canonical AppKit Persistence Isolation
nodes.rationale: Only the complete macOS -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState launch form is recognized, preserving normal restoration outside UI tests.

nodes.label: Bounded Initial-Window Recovery
nodes.rationale: A bounded readiness check uses the sole structural File-menu action only when no window exists and then requires exactly one content window.

nodes.label: Throwing UI-Test Prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Missing menus, roots, or actionable elements fail immediately before secondary interactions can obscure the cause.

nodes.label: Network Cancellation Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Explicit cancellation checks around monitor notification and delayed stubbing prevent work after cancellation without rewriting construction or adaptation failures.

nodes.label: Sandbox Client-Network Entitlement
nodes.rationale: The macOS app receives client networking only, avoiding unnecessary server or group capabilities.

nodes.label: Remove Hosted CI Automation Implementation Plan
Hosted CI Artifact Removal
nodes.rationale: Deleting the only active workflow removes hosted automation cleanly without relocating or silently disabling it.

nodes.label: Local Verification Contract
nodes.rationale: macOS, iPhone, iPad, signing, and entitlement checks remain local release responsibilities after hosted CI removal.

nodes.label: Operation-Scoped SwiftData Persistence
nodes.rationale: Operation-scoped contexts, explicit state-changing saves, bounded reads, and cancellation checks confine SwiftData behavior and avoid leaking persistent models.

nodes.label: Frozen V1 Schema Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Genericizing the API must preserve the shipped schema and existing ExampleRecord disk data byte-for-byte at the persistence boundary.

nodes.label: iPad UI Gate Stabilization Implementation Plan
Postcondition-Gated Bounded Retry
nodes.rationale: A single retry occurs only when the semantic Browse destination is absent, containing the workaround to test interaction without weakening assertions.

nodes.label: App-Private Data Protection Keychain Policy
nodes.rationale: Generic-password items are nonsynchronizable, WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly, and omit access groups to minimize capability and disclosure scope.

nodes.label: AppTemplate.AppState Physical Compatibility
nodes.rationale: The typed service preserves the existing physical key, raw Data representation, current-schema bytes, and untouched future-schema bytes.

nodes.label: Locked Raw UserDefaults Boundary
nodes.rationale: All raw access is serialized under one lock while codecs run outside it, preserving reentrancy and strict physical-type validation.

nodes.label: Native Adaptive SwiftUI Navigation
nodes.rationale: Native TabView, NavigationStack, and NavigationSplitView preserve platform behavior while typed scene-local routes keep navigation testable and restorable.

nodes.label: Apple: Enhancing Your App Content with Tab Navigation
Explicit Dependency Lifetimes
nodes.rationale: The composition root owns application services and stores while each scene owns its router, preventing accidental shared navigation state.

nodes.label: Explicit Typed Injection
nodes.rationale: Immutable factories and initializer injection avoid service locators, global overrides, and hidden environment dependencies.

nodes.label: Identifier-Only Navigation Resolution
nodes.rationale: Deep links and restoration route stable identifiers without repository I/O; missing records render a not-found state.

nodes.label: Router-Owned Navigation
nodes.rationale: Routers retain navigation authority; a ViewModel receives only a narrowly scoped router when its screen actually emits navigation actions.

nodes.label: Cancellation and Stale-Response Rejection
nodes.rationale: Task cancellation and request versioning prevent obsolete asynchronous results from overwriting newer screen state.

nodes.label: Neutral Local and Remote Model Examples Design
Neutral Model Independence
nodes.rationale: Independent immutable Sendable examples teach role classification without implying a workflow or coupling local and remote types.

nodes.label: Compile-Safe Reserved Extension Points
nodes.rationale: Empty extension points communicate intended growth without registering, instantiating, or pretending to implement unused infrastructure.

nodes.label: Tests Mirror Production Ownership
nodes.rationale: Mirrored test paths make architectural ownership and the corresponding verification boundary visible together.

nodes.label: Screen Capsule and Service-Only Architecture Design
Service-Only Data Access
nodes.rationale: A single Service abstraction removes a parallel Repository layer and keeps the app graph to feature-dependency to service path direct.

nodes.label: SessionPhase Service-Owned Boundary
nodes.rationale: SessionPhase remains dedicated state and SessionStore retains mutable behavior, avoiding an overgeneralized LoadableState abstraction.

nodes.label: Domain Model Ownership Rules
nodes.rationale: Domain contains only shared business entities; state, persistence DTOs, network DTOs, and screen presentation data remain with their actual owners.

nodes.label: Empty Domain Model Removal
nodes.rationale: Removing unused Authentication, Home, and Settings model placeholders keeps the domain layer truthful instead of speculative.

nodes.label: Screen-Owned Outgoing Navigation
nodes.rationale: Each screen owns the route, destination, ViewModel, and presentation it emits, so navigation evolves within feature boundaries.
